hook.text: Every voice-typing app, in one meeting
hook.caption: Pitch meeting: who gets to turn my voice into text?

FOUNDER.description: Smooth, confident, slightly too pleased with himself. Polished startup-pitch cadence, a hint of smugness.

BUILTIN.description: Flat, crackly, slow. Old dial-up-modem-era voice, tired and tinny, like a 1990s answering machine.

SALES.description: Fast, bright, over-eager used-car-salesman energy. Relentlessly upbeat, talking just a bit too quickly.

TUCKY.description: Warm, calm, gentle and unhurried. Friendly and reassuring, a smile in the voice.

shots.text: We turn your voice into text. Fifteen dollars a month.
Your audio goes to our servers and comes back smarter.
Ours runs on YOUR Mac. Private. Fast.
For a model… on my Mac.
Hold a key. Talk. The ums vanish. Nothing leaves the Mac. Free.
